E1 - The Invasion Begins
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

programme.title: E3 - Punks on the Run
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride’s territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava’s survival skills are still intact.

programme.title: E6 - Here Comes the Rain
programme.desc: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

programme.title: E2 - Life's Lessons
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: E3 - Life's Legacies
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: E1 - The Ghost of the Mountains
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: E2 - To Catch a Legend
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: E1 - Meet the Jaguars
programme.desc: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

programme.title: E1 - Raw Power

programme.title: E3 - Heat

programme.title: E6 - Here Comes the Rain

programme.title: E2 - Life's Lessons
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: E3 - Life's Legacies
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: E1 - The Ghost of the Mountains

programme.title: E2 - To Catch a Legend
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, skipper Dwane leads his crew into the waters of Fiordland on the southern coast of New Zealand. It’s all hands on deck as the divers work relentlessly to collect tonnes of urchin. As the weather deteriorates, of the crew gets a scare from below the surface.

programme.title: E7 - Shaquille O'Neil
programme.desc: Bear and NBA legend Shaquille O'Neal are lifted from a freight train via helicopter and whisked away to a dense forest in the remote Adirondacks; they face blood-sucking leeches and a 200-foot rock face as they search for their exit.

programme.title: E5 - Ukraine
programme.desc: Back in Eastern Europe, Catfish and Rooftop start their visit Ukraine dropping into the country via skydive. The adventures only get crazier from there- from wrangling pigs and racing ostriches to testing out if their heads can survive a Spetsnaz bottle break. After testing out the bottle break the duo move onto sambo, a Soviet style of wrestling and equally challenging event. The BMX bikers become the first people to trick at Chernobyl (and get a lifetime ban), but before they head out to their next stop, the two finish their trip just like they came in- airborne. Only this time they’re leaving by fighter jet.

programme.title: MAN WANTED 3
programme.desc: Street boy Qian Jidong had been idolizing Pujun, one of the 'Double Eagles in Mong Kok' since childhood. His father was beaten because he owed Xiyang a loan, so Qian Jidong went to Xiyang desperately, but was captured by Xiyang. At a critical moment, Pujun appeared and saved his life. Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him...

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers

programme.title: Fighting to Survive
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve...

programme.title: Esprit D'Amour
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 《天啟異聞錄》講述了天啟年間，一場神秘疫病爆發，錦衣衛褚思鏡（黃軒飾）在孤島存亡危機中歷險破局的故事。 天啟年間，遼東關外怪病肆虐，人心惶惶，一錦衣衛隻身北上探查，不料卻卷入當地軍民鬥爭，在終日籠罩遼東的迷霧之後，武術詭譎陰謀也正潛滋暗長，無形的觸手正伺機而動……

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 《天啟異聞錄》講述了天啟年間，一場神秘疫病爆發，錦衣衛褚思鏡（黃軒飾）在孤島存亡危機中歷險破局的故事。 天啟年間，遼東關外怪病肆虐，人心惶惶，一錦衣衛隻身北上探查，不料卻卷入當地軍民鬥爭，在終日籠罩遼東的迷霧之後，武術詭譎陰謀也正潛滋暗長，無形的觸手正伺機而動……

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E32
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: 2gether: The Movie
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.
